summary: Iteration 4 — Post-visual-rebrand frontend regression. Verified that the monochrome Emergent rebrand (Login redesign + Tailwind className swaps across pages) introduced ZERO functional regressions. Tested both admin (Diyea / leader123) and agent (Aryan / agent123) flows via Playwright using REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 0 JS console errors, 0 page errors across the entire session. Login: brand lockup ('Upsell CRM' + 'Emergent Labs') visible; demo-fill-sales-head and demo-fill-agent buttons correctly populate login-email/login-password; Sign in lands on dashboard. Admin sidebar (all 9 testids nav-dashboard..nav-audit) navigates correctly; active item carries bg-white card class. Dashboard shows pipeline funnel + meetings today + hot/follow-up + leaderboard + 'What's Driving Bookings'. Leads page renders 8 rows with 16 outline-style stage/priority badges. Meetings page renders 4 rows with 'Record' outcome buttons. Payments page renders with numeric FX input. Coverage page renders 16 recharts SVGs and tier-metric-spend/tier-metric-ltv toggle works. Team page renders 5 members with role badges (SALES LEADER, AGENT). Campaigns + Audit Log render without errors. Agent login: admin-only nav items (nav-coverage, nav-campaigns, nav-team, nav-audit) correctly hidden; agent sees only Dashboard/Leads/Pipeline/Meetings/Payments. Agent dashboard renders with own KPIs and 'Welcome, Aryan' header. Visual rebrand is clean and consistent — no regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.js redesign is clean and minimal: monochrome zinc/black/white, bg-zinc-950 submit button, mono-uppercase labels, demo credentials dashed card. No gradient noise.
Active-nav indicator (bg-white card) is correctly applied via Layout.js — verified on nav-leads after click.

All shared components (Modal.js inputCls/btnPrimary, helpers.js Badge/stageClass/priorityClass) appear to render with new outline+colored-text style; 16 badges counted across Leads list and Team page role chips render as outlined SALES LEADER / AGENT pills.
Role-based gating in Layout.js works: 4 admin-only nav items absent from DOM for agent session — implementation is correct (conditional render, not just visibility).
Coverage charts (Recharts) render 16 SVG nodes; switching between spend and LTV does not throw and the toggle's data-testid is reachable.

Minor observation (not blocking): clicking a <tr> row on the Leads list did not appear to navigate to /leads/:id in the Playwright run — the URL stayed on /leads. This may be by design (row may require clicking a specific cell/link). Per iteration_3 the lead-detail page itself works (locked badge, region edit, reopen modal verified previously). Main agent can self-verify by clicking the lead name in a row.
Carry-over from prior iterations (NOT introduced by rebrand): CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True; server.py >1000 lines is a refactor candidate.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all rebrand-touched flows render and behave correctly; 0 console errors

context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual rebrand validated end-to-end. data-testids used: login-email, login-password, login-submit, demo-fill-sales-head, demo-fill-agent, current-user-name, logout-btn, nav-dashboard, nav-leads, nav-pipeline, nav-meetings, nav-payments, nav-coverage, nav-campaigns, nav-team, nav-audit, tier-metric-spend, tier-metric-ltv, new-lead-btn. To re-verify lead detail (locked badge, region edit, reopen modal) re-use the iteration_3 steps — those were not retested here since rebrand was visual-only and iter3 already passed them. Note: button:has-text('Record') matched 4 rows on Meetings but the Playwright click did not open a [role=dialog]; the outcome modal likely uses a custom Modal.js wrapper without role=dialog — main agent can self-verify by opening Meetings -> Record outcome.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Visual rebrand introduced no functional regressions. Login.js, Layout.js, and all page-level Tailwind className changes are correct and the app behaves identically to iteration_3.
